import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('.')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',base/'programs/task-452f8261.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def read(p): return [[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in Path(p).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
demo=read('demo452.txt')
out=m.transform(demo)
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r0,r1,c0,c1 in [(2,7,4,9),(2,7,20,26),(12,16,22,26),(17,22,10,16)]:
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): expected[r][c]=4
print('demo match:',out==expected,'changed cells:',sum(a!=b for x,y in zip(demo,out) for a,b in zip(x,y)))
test=read('test452.txt')
ans=m.transform(test)
print('test dimensions:',len(ans),len(ans[0]))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in ans))
PY
